1.texto_original: ¶ Botyah-botyah, kowé uga wis dadi siji karo Gusti, mulané kowé kudu manut marang wong tuwamu. Kuwi pantyèn bener, awit mbiyèn-mbiyèné Gusti Allah wis ngomong ngéné: “Ngajènana marang bapa lan biyungmu.” Kuwi wèté Gusti Allah sing ndisik déwé sing nggandèng prejanjian ngéné: “Supaya kowé pada slamet lan uripmu nang jagat kéné bisa dawa umuré.”
1.normal:
Devotional Study of Efése 6:1

"¶ Botyah-botyah, kowé uga wis dadi siji karo Gusti, mulané kowé kudu manut marang wong tuwamu. Kuwi pantyèn bener, awit mbiyèn-mbiyèné Gusti Allah wis ngomong ngéné: “Ngajènana marang bapa lan biyungmu.” Kuwi wèté Gusti Allah sing ndisik déwé sing nggandèng prejanjian ngéné: “Supaya kowé pada slamet lan uripmu nang jagat kéné bisa dawa umuré.”"

This verse carries deep theological significance. The original Hebrew/Greek text reveals layers of meaning that illuminate Gods character and purposes. The context within the broader narrative provides essential framework for understanding.

The historical backdrop adds richness to interpretation. Archaeological discoveries continue to confirm and illuminate the cultural setting in which these words were written.

For the modern reader, this verse offers both comfort and challenge. It invites us to trust in Gods sovereign plan while actively living out its principles in daily life.
